hypotheses.reasoning: GET /search 500s originate in the catalog write path. catalog-svc S3 uploads to s3://search-artifacts-prod start failing at 20:37:52 (#1231, 503 ServiceUnavailable from us-east-1), then 500 InternalError from AWS (#1285, #1384) and more 503s (#1431). search-api then fails CatalogClient.getBatch with 'storage write failed' (#1273, #1463, #1508, #1754), and web-bff returns 500 on /search (#1226, #1302, #1634). The BFF 500s are downstream. No S3 errors occur before 20:37:52. The auth-svc IdP slowdown (#720 to #886) and account-svc pool saturation drive /login 503s, a separate path. The aws-sdk retry quota exhaustion (#1323) is amplification, so cascading_failure is a close alternative.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check us-east-1 S3 status and the health of the search-artifacts-prod bucket. Mitigate by making catalog-svc S3 writes non-blocking for /search (serve last good index or queue artifact writes for retry). Cap SDK retries with backoff and jitter. Track the separate auth-svc IdP timeouts (#886, #1009) and account-svc pool saturation as a /login incident.
